title: Luxurious Fried Vietnamese Cashew Nuts Cha Gio
description: A festive Vietnamese dish featuring cashew nuts and shio-koji cure, this recipe is low in glycemic index and made in the form of cha gio, providing a delicious and unique culinary experience.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together chopped cashew nuts, shio-koji, cooked pork sausage, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, black pepper, and salt.
Lay a rice paper wrapper on a flat surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the cashew nut mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Fold the bottom half of the wrapper over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat to 350 degrees.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the cha gio to the pan and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the cha gio from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the cha gio hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining cha gio.
